record.context_brief: Long odd and even cycle conjecture
record.original_question: Fix k >= 2. If G has m edges and contains neither C_{2k+1} nor C_{2k+2}, must lambda(G) be at most (k - 1 + sqrt(4m - k^2 + 1)) / 2, with equality only for K_k joined with an independent set of size m/k - (k - 1)/2, for all sufficiently large m?

evidence.quote: Conjecture 3.10 (Zhai, Lin and Shu [44], 2021). Let k >= 2 be a fixed integer. If G in G(m, C2k+1) union G(m, C2k+2) and m is sufficiently large, then lambda(G) <= (k-1+sqrt(4m-k^2+1))/2.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $k \ge 2$ be a fixed integer. For a simple graph $G$, let $\lambda(G)$ denote the spectral radius of its adjacency matrix, and let $e(G)$ denote its number of edges. For an integer $\ell \ge 3$, let $C_\ell$ denote the cycle of length $\ell$. Let $S_{n,k}$ denote the join $K_k \vee \overline{K_{n-k}}$, i.e., the graph obtained from a clique on $k$ vertices and an independent set on $n-k$ vertices by adding all edges between the two parts.

Prove or disprove the following: there exists $m_0 = m_0(k)$ such that for every simple graph $G$ with $m \ge m_0$ edges that contains neither $C_{2k+1}$ nor $C_{2k+2}$ as a subgraph, one has
$$\lambda(G) \le \frac{k-1 + \sqrt{4m - k^2 + 1}}{2},$$
with equality if and only if $G \cong S_{n,k}$ where $n = m/k + (k-1)/2$ (so that in particular $k \mid 2m + k(k-1)$ in any equality case), i.e., $G$ is isomorphic to $K_k$ joined with an independent set of size $m/k - (k-1)/2$.
artifact.status_search_result: The conjecture (attributed to Zhai, Lin and Shu, 2021) concerning the spectral-radius upper bound for graphs of given size avoiding both $C_{2k+1}$ and $C_{2k+2}$ has been reported as resolved. Recent surveys and follow-up works on spectral extremal problems for cycles of given size discuss this conjecture as having been settled.

status_evidence.title: Spectral Radius of Graphs with Given Size and Odd Girth
status_evidence.snippet: Results on spectral radius for graphs of given size avoiding short odd cycles, related to the Zhai-Lin-Shu conjecture.
status_evidence.claim: Progress on the spectral radius bound for graphs of given size with forbidden cycles.

status_evidence.title: Unsolved Problems in Spectral Graph Theory
status_evidence.snippet: Survey listing conjectures including those of Zhai, Lin and Shu on spectral radius bounds for graphs forbidding consecutive cycles.
status_evidence.claim: Conjecture context for the bound (k-1+sqrt(4m-k^2+1))/2 with extremal graph S_{n,k}.
